notes: Pokémon Vault (PKHeX-style storage): an app-side box that isn't tied to any game. In a Gen 3 game's Edit save → PC Boxes, long-press a Pokémon to 'Save to Vault'. Then Settings → Pokémon Vault to copy or clone it into any other Gen 3 game (Ruby/Sapphire/Emerald/FireRed/LeafGreen), duplicate it, or remove it. Copies are backed up first and marked caught in the target game's Pokédex. Cross-generation (to DS) is a future step.
